configurePresets.name: pitchguide-dev
configurePresets.description: Side-by-side dev plugin identity with ARA diagnostic logging. Optimized, so realtime behaviour in the DAW matches a release build, but symbols are kept so the VS debugger can attach to ARA callbacks. Logs to %APPDATA%/PitchGuide/Logs/. NOTE: these are Ninja presets, which inherit the target architecture from the environment - configure from Visual Studio or an x64 developer shell, never a plain prompt, or cl.exe silently targets x86 and the x64 ONNX Runtime will not link.

configurePresets.name: pitchguide-dev-debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimized dev build with asserts live. Use only for stepping through logic that RelWithDebInfo optimizes away - realtime performance in a DAW is not representative and dropouts here are not real bugs.

configurePresets.name: pitchguide-release
configurePresets.description: Shipping identity, no diagnostics. This is the build that must keep resolving for projects saved against a released PitchGuide.
